intro: Habakkuk is a conversation between a prophet and God.
In chapter one, Habakkuk asks why God allows injustice, and is shocked by the answer. In chapter two, God tells him to wait, and says: the just shall live by his faith.
Chapter three is a song of trust.
Little is known of Habakkuk himself.
Listen for the ending: although the fig tree shall not blossom, yet I will rejoice in the LORD.
